name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-10.1
description: 10.1" 800x1280 MIPI-DSI panel (JD9365) with GT911 touch on an ESP32-P4. Compiled, not yet seen on a board.
verify: Nobody at LCD Wizard has had this board: the export for it compiles and has not been seen on the panel. Pins and the panel's start-up table are from Waveshare's own BSP (esp32_p4_wifi6_touch_lcd_x) and so are the settings (80 MHz, a VSYNC back porch of 10, 1500 Mbps a lane: what Waveshare's ESP-IDF code runs). If the screen stays dark with the backlight lit, try 60 MHz with a VSYNC back porch of 12 and 750 Mbps a lane, which is what GFX Library for Arduino's own definition of the board runs. These boards ship with ESP32-P4 chips of both generations: the export builds for a chip before revision 3 (see the README for the other). The touch controller may answer at 0x14 instead of 0x5D. The TF card, audio codec, camera connector and the ESP32-C6 radio are not driven.
